coverage.note: 2,864 OCR pages; 12,195 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets (10,382 before --alias for the paper's Leiand/Letand/Ldand/Lebnd/Loland, Sunnydate and Schwenn spellings). ocr_mentions.py kept 545 windows; 92 advertiser-dropped and 148 ad-dropped windows carrying a strong event word were added back, plus 39 more from the aliased spellings: 824 windows read by hand by seven readers. 204 candidates; 117 set aside before entry - duplicates of one event across issues (about 40), bare occupancy of a well-known institution with no event (about 40), a shop's presence, a plan never confirmed, an undated claim, a number too damaged to read, and two fires at a private house. 87 findings written: 71 resolved, 16 unresolved (9 with no EAS record - 101 Raymond, 133 Leland, 1704 Sunnydale, 675 and 676 Polk, 876 Stevenson, 1166 Market, 2819 San Jose, 3942 San Bruno - and 7 placed by hand as unsafe). 66 published on 45 pages (18 seeded), 5 declined as repeats of what the page carried or undated.
